title: CAULIFLOWER IN MAYONNAISE
instructions: --Select some large, cold boiled cauliflowers and break into small branches, adding a little salt,  pepper and vinegar to properly season. Heap them on a dish to form a point. Surround with a garnish of cooked carrots,  turnips and green vegetables, pour some white mayonnaise sauce over all, and serve.
